# temps_project_skill (Resource)

A skill (instructions in Markdown) only the AI agents of one project can load.

Import with `<project_id>/<slug>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_skill" "release_notes" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  slug       = "release-notes"
  name       = "Release notes"
  content    = file("${path.module}/skills/release-notes.md")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The skill's Markdown.
- `name` (String) Name of the skill.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `slug` (String) Identifier of the skill.

### Optional

- `description` (String) When an agent should use it.

### Read-Only

- `has_archive` (Boolean) Whether supporting files were uploaded with it.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>/<slug>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<slug>
terraform import temps_project_skill.release_notes 8/release-notes
```
